title: A more alive Evia
details: Evia now has subtle idle movement, natural eye glances, blinking and occasional head tilts
Evia reacts when you tap her and gives a small happy expression after successful evidence actions
Future app updates now appear as a clear notification on the Evia home screen with a direct Update Evia action
The home update notification stays out of the way while menus and QR screens are open
summary: Evia feels more alive and new versions are now surfaced directly on the home screen.
changes: Added low-key avatar life animations and reactions
Refreshed the complete offline shell to v108
